notes: S4.1 states that reg0 or reg1 changes only if the corresponding valid write occurs. The phrase "changes only if" is an explicit necessary-condition claim and is therefore interpreted literally under guideline v1.1 rather than being automatically restricted to the reset-disabled runtime domain. A synchronous reset can change a nonzero register to zero without any valid write, providing a legal counterexample. The normal write behavior and final RTL are otherwise correct, and trusted simulation and bounded formal verification pass all obligations.
